'''Shivena Kayenzi''' was a [[Saldaea]]n philosopher.

== History ==
She was influenced by [[Willim of Maneches]]. She claimed that reality was an illusion.

== Activities ==
[[Meilyn Arganya]] questions [[Moiraine Damodred]] on the influence of Shivena's ideas as part of her classes as [[Accepted]] in the [[White Tower]].{{ref/book|0|8}}
